report_stale.why: export_report_docx/export_report_pdf (and the export route) on a report version whose stored evidence_hash is not the project's evidence hash now: the study changed since it was written (LC48B-STALE-1). Nothing is rendered or saved; the assistant generates the report again, then exports.

report_interrupted.why: GET /reports/generate/status after a server restart when the project's on-disk job marker (reports/.job.json) still reads running and this process has no job record: the job was interrupted; status interrupted, its report_id, hint 'generate the report again'; nothing re-runs it (LC48B-RESUME-1)
